flags.why: This meaning also belongs to general Vietnamese and is not specifically Southern ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ng%E1%BB%99)).
The example defines enlightenment instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Ông đạt tới ngộ sau nhiều năm tu tập. = He attained enlightenment after many years of Buddhist practice.

flags.why: The entry omits Earth, the planet itself, a central meaning of địa cầu ([dictionary](https://vi.glosbe.com/vi/en/%C4%90%E1%BB%8Ba%20C%E1%BA%A7u)).
flags.fix: Add noun: Earth; the globe (the planet).

flags.why: Tuốt means stripping or pulling something out, not whittling or sharpening ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-tu%E1%BB%91t)).
The intestinal-worm meaning is Southern regional usage and needs a regional warning.
